## Public Transit & Parking Directions
- **Light Rail (Dankal Red Line)**: **Yehudit Station** (`תחנת יהודית`) — 350 meters / 4-minute walk via Menachem Begin Rd → Hamasger St → Gershon Shatz St 36.
- **Israel Railways (Train)**: **Tel Aviv HaShalom Station** (`תחנת רכבת השלום`) — 750 meters / 8–10 minute walk via HaShalom Rd → Hamasger St → Gershon Shatz St 36.
- **Parking**: Paid municipal street parking (Blue & White curb markings via Pango/Cello) on Gershon Shatz St and surrounding Montefiore streets, or nearby private paid parking lots.

## Participant Rules & Facility Regulations (תקנון)
- **Minimum Pilot Age**: **10+ years old**. Participants aged **10–15** must be accompanied by an adult (18+).
- **Booking Customer Age**: Online reservations and credit card payments must be made by an adult aged **18+**.
- **Cockpit Observers (Jumpseat Guests)**: Up to **2 companions** may watch inside the cockpit free of charge.
- **Arrival Time**: Participants must arrive **5 minutes prior** to their scheduled session time.
- **Late Arrival Policy**: Session time includes the pre-flight briefing inside the cockpit. Delays exceeding **10 minutes** may result in a shortened session (without refund for lost time) or rescheduling subject to a change fee.
- **Nature of Facility**: The simulator is a 1:1 scale experiential & entertainment Boeing 737 flight deck accompanied by an instructor; it is not an official pilot licensing institution.

## Flight Packages & Pricing (ILS)
- **Basic Flight Session — Takeoff & Landing Exercise (20 Min)**: ₪250 ILS (Single airport circuit, modular base)
- **Daytime Special Flight — 45m Promo (45 Min)**: ₪490 ILS (Available daytime Sun–Fri < 18:00, 2 full landings)
- **The Captain's Command Flight (60 Min)**: ₪690 ILS (Bestseller • Takeoff/Landing + 1 World Airport Trio included)
- **Captains' Challenge & Multi-Trio Odyssey (90 Min)**: ₪850 ILS Daytime / ₪950 ILS Prime-Time (Takeoff/Landing + 2 World Trios + Emergencies, 1–2 pilots)
- **Fear of Flying Overcoming Course (60 Min)**: ₪690 ILS (Therapeutic aviophobia coaching with airline captain)
- **Airline Interview Prep 60 PRO (60 Min)**: ₪890 ILS (Raw Data, steep turns, ILS screening prep)
- **Airline Interview Prep 90 PRO (90 Min)**: ₪1,250 ILS (Full airline screening profile, V1 Cut, single-engine ILS)
- **Airline Interview Prep 120 PRO (120 Min)**: ₪1,590 ILS (Comprehensive airline assessment & abnormal QRH checkride)
- **Corporate CRM Leadership Workshop (240 Min)**: ₪4,500 ILS (Executive CRM team offsite, 5–12 participants)
